traits.name: High Winds
traits.text: (air, aura); 20 feet. Air within the emanation is difficult terrain for Flying creatures that do not have the air trait.

traits.name: Disperse
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The living whirlwind takes damage from a hostile action. Effect The storm lord disperses. Until the end of the current turn, it can't be attacked or targeted, doesn't take up space, and any auras or emanations it has are suppressed. At the end of the turn, the storm lord reforms in any space in which it can fit within 50 feet of where it dispersed and any auras or emanations it has are restored as long as their duration didn't run out while it was dispersed.

traits.name: Swiftness
traits.text: The storm lord's movement doesn't trigger reactions.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ gust +20 (finesse, reach 15 feet); Damage 2d12+10 (2d12+10) bludgeoning plus Push 5 feet

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ lightning lash +20 (range increment 50 feet); Damage 2d12+4 (2d12+4) electricity
